name: ToggleGroup
description: A row or column of joined toggle buttons with shared borders, for formatting options or a choice between a few modes. Pick single or multiple selection.

selectionMode.description: One pressed item at most, or any number.

orientation.description: Direction of the group. Arrow keys follow it.

size.description: Item height, from the shared control sizes.

variant.description: Outline draws a border around every item; ghost has no border until an item is hovered or pressed.

disallowEmptySelection.description: Keeps one item pressed at all times.

children.description: ToggleGroupItem elements, each with an id. Control the pressed ids with selectedKeys, defaultSelectedKeys and onSelectionChange.

keyboard: Tab moves focus into the group and out of it; only one item is in the tab order
Arrow keys move focus between items, following the orientation
Space or Enter toggles the focused item
Home and End move to the first and last item
requirements: The group has an accessible name through aria-label or aria-labelledby
In single mode the group is a radiogroup and items are radios; in multiple mode items expose aria-pressed
An icon-only item has an aria-label
The pressed state is shown by fill and weight, not only by color
Joined borders keep a 3:1 contrast against the background
screenReader: Items are announced as pressed or not pressed, or as checked radios in single mode
A disabled item is announced as dimmed or unavailable

use_when: A formatting toolbar where several options can be on
Alignment or view mode where one of a few is on
avoid_when: Switching the content of a panel: use Tabs or SegmentedControl
One on or off setting: use Switch
More than about six options: use Select
anti_patterns: A group with no accessible name
Mixing text and icon items in one group
